note: Every behavioural claim on the landing page names the mechanism that keeps it and the tests that prove it. A claim with requires[] is shown with a condition footnote (#claim-conditions).

requirements.branch-protection: GitHub branch protection that requires the Getzilla check

claims.text: Getzilla keeps this out of main until it is fixed.
claims.mechanism: Required checks on main: the CI gate (getzilla ci) or Trust CI must pass on the exact head; getzilla doctor --enforcement reports whether main is actually protected.

claims.text: Tests that actually ran, on the exact version you ship
claims.mechanism: Verification receipts are bound to the reviewed tree; the stop gate refuses a "tests passed" claim without a current receipt.
The final check runs in Trust CI on a separate server against the exact commit, with holdout specifications the agent cannot read; reviews pass only for the reviewed identity.

claims.text: Hidden tests the agent cannot edit
claims.mechanism: Trust CI holdout change specifications live outside the repository and are validated against the exact commit.

claims.text: A typo gets a light touch.
claims.mechanism: Proven-trivial profile (L01): a prose-only diff at low risk needs verification and one review; a prompt alone or raised risk never waives.

claims.text: Payments and logins get the full treatment.
claims.mechanism: Risk is the maximum of the prompt and the diff (H01); payment and authentication terms route to the full profile.
